AbilitiesResponse.description: Body of GET /api/v1/access/me/abilities: what the caller may do (the UI hides the rest).
AbilitiesResponse.title: AbilitiesResponse

AuthErrorResponse.description: Body of a 401/403 on an authenticated route. Never names a tenant or a user.
AuthErrorResponse.title: AuthErrorResponse

HealthResponse.description: Body of GET /api/v1/health. Changing it changes the generated client (STACK-03).
HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse

JobOut.description: A job as the jobs API shows it. The payload stays server-side (it may hold record data).
JobOut.title: JobOut

JobPage.description: Newest first. ``next_cursor`` is the last item's id (job ids are UUIDv7, time-ordered).
JobPage.title: JobPage

JobStatus.description: Stable internal job status codes (labels come from terminology keys, never these).
JobStatus.title: JobStatus

LimitOut.description: ``limit`` null is unlimited; ``used`` null means nothing measures it yet.
LimitOut.title: LimitOut

LintFindingOut.description: One raw label found by the TERMS-07 scanner (lines and columns 1-based).
LintFindingOut.title: LintFindingOut

LoginStartResponse.description: Same status and keys whether or not the email or domain is known; never the tenant.
LoginStartResponse.title: LoginStartResponse

MeResponse.description: The caller's own user, tenant and memberships. Never another tenant's data.
MeResponse.title: MeResponse

ModuleInfo.description: A mounted module as reported by the registry.
ModuleInfo.title: ModuleInfo

OrganisationList.description: Every live organisation that matches, by name (a tenant has tens, not thousands).
OrganisationList.title: OrganisationList

OrganisationUpdate.description: Only the fields sent are changed; ``syncVersion`` is the version the client last read.
OrganisationUpdate.title: OrganisationUpdate

OverrideCreate.description: A boolean for ``feature.*``; a count, or null for unlimited, for ``limit.*``.
OverrideCreate.title: OverrideCreate

PlanAndUsage.description: The read-only "Plan and usage" page. No prices, invoices or payment data.
PlanAndUsage.title: PlanAndUsage

ProjectUpdate.description: Only the fields sent are changed; ``syncVersion`` is the version the client last read.
ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate

RoleUpdate.description: Every field optional. A system role keeps its code and name (409 SYSTEM_ROLE_IMMUTABLE).
RoleUpdate.title: RoleUpdate

SessionOut.description: One of the caller's own live sessions (the "Active sessions" page).
SessionOut.title: SessionOut

SiteUpdate.description: Only the fields sent are changed.
SiteUpdate.title: SiteUpdate

StepUpErrorResponse.description: 401 from a critical action: confirm with a second factor at ``stepUpUrl``, then retry.
StepUpErrorResponse.title: StepUpErrorResponse

SubscriptionPut.description: An operator sets the subscription; ``contract_ref`` is required for production terms.
SubscriptionPut.title: SubscriptionPut

TenantErrorResponse.description: Body of a 401/403 from ``require_active_tenant``. Never names the tenant.
TenantErrorResponse.title: TenantErrorResponse

TenantView.description: The caller's tenant as other modules and the API see it.
TenantView.title: TenantView

TermsCoverage.description: Body of GET /api/v1/terms/coverage: the findings baked into the running build.
TermsCoverage.title: TermsCoverage

VersionResponse.description: Body of GET /api/v1/platform/version. Changing it changes the generated client.
VersionResponse.title: VersionResponse
